column_description: A BIGSERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each order (e.g., 15002).
A CHAR(10) referencing the exchange ID (e.g., 'BINANCE').
A VARCHAR(30) naming the market pair or trading symbol (e.g., 'BTC/USDT').
A CHAR(36) external or client order ID (e.g., 'CL-3c4a8f89-9aed').
A CHAR(36) FK to Users(UserStamp), linking this order to its owner.
An enum (OrderTune_enum) describing order type (Stop, Market, Limit, StopLimit).
A DECIMAL(12,3) capturing the limit or stop price (e.g., '27800.500').
A NUMERIC(12,4) for the order quantity (e.g., '0.1250').
An enum (OrderFlow_enum) describing the status (New, PartiallyFilled, Cancelled, Filled).
An enum (TimeSpan_enum) for time-in-force (IOC, GTC, GTD, FOK).
An enum (OrderBase_enum) indicating how the order was placed (API, Web, Mobile, Bot).
A VARCHAR(80) holding an optional client-supplied tag (e.g., 'myXtrOrder001').
A TIMESTAMP showing when the order was first persisted (e.g., '2025-05-10 13:45:00').
A TIMESTAMP noting the last update to this order (e.g., '2025-05-10 14:02:15').
